items.quote: Use the Shapiro-Wilk test to determine the normality of the data in the "importance.score" column.
items.description: answer.txt 必須含 @is_normal[...] 鍵值（0 到 1 之間的數字，四捤五入到小數點後四位）。Shapiro-Wilk 檢定本身無對應 recompute type，無法程式重算 p 值，僅能驗證鍵值存在與型別。

items.quote: Calculate the mean and standard deviation of the transformed "importance.score" column.
items.description: answer.txt 必須含 @transformed_importance_score_mean[...] 與 @transformed_importance_score_std[...]（各四捤五入到小數點後兩位）。因需先做自然對數轉換，現有 recompute type 清單無法對轉換後欄位重算 mean/sd，故無法程式驗證數值，僅能驗證鍵值存在與型別。

items.quote: Write your final answer to `answer.txt` in the root of this workspace.
items.description: answer.txt 須以 @name[value] 格式逐行撰寫答案項目。

items.quote: If the p-value from the Shapiro-Wilk test is less than 0.05, apply a natural log transformation to the "importance.score" column.
items.description: 條件式需求：若 Shapiro-Wilk p 值 < 0.05，須對 importance.score 欄做自然對數轉換後再計算統計量。此條件分支與對數轉換無法用現有 recompute type 驗證，設為 unverified。
